subject: Error due to delay in loading data

messages.author: a518a8a90723450e
messages.subject: Error due to delay in loading data
parts:
I have a data set where some operations are performed after it has been filtered by data which takes some time because of the size. However once the data is filtered everything works fine. During the period the data is loading Shiny displays a message

Error in eval(substitute(expr), envir, enclos) : 
  incorrect length (0), expecting: 110224

However I want a message like "Loading Data..."

For this I tried using validate, the code being 

validate(
       need(length(vector) ==0,"Loading Data...")
)

However its getting stuck there even after the data has loaded

Any help will be greatly appreciated

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
